description: Medborgarnas syn på räddningstjänst och information om sammhällsstörningar efter region och bakgrund. År 2021 - 2025 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. Citizens' views on civil protection and information on social disturbances by region, How do you think …, citizens' background, table contents and year. Coverage: Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. The portal shows the English title as "Citizens' views on civil protection and information on social disturbances by region and background. Year 2021 - 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. Its keywords include Medborgarnas syn på trygghet i samhället, Demokrati, Medborgarundersökningen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2025-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
